subject.title: feat: Add Anthropic server-side compaction API support

question: Should Anthropic-native compaction be exposed as provider-owned model/run params, folded into the existing compaction provider surface, or deferred into the broader Anthropic context-management design?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent API crosses public config, provider request payloads, stream/session replay semantics, and overlapping context-management requests.

options.title: Provider-Owned Opt-In Params
options.body: Add Anthropic-specific opt-in model/run parameters and docs while leaving local/pluggable compaction unchanged by default.

options.title: Compaction Provider Surface
options.body: Route Anthropic native compaction through the existing compaction provider setting, accepting that the provider seam would cover more than local summarization backends.

options.title: Broader Design First
options.body: Hold this focused tracker until maintainers settle the umbrella Anthropic context-management API with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54041.

recommendation.title: Provider-Owned Opt-In Params
recommendation.body: Add Anthropic-specific opt-in model/run parameters and docs while leaving local/pluggable compaction unchanged by default.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current review context across the affected compaction/config surfaces and already participated in this issue's maintainer-facing discussion.
